description: This file provides various functions for retrieving MAC addresses from different hardware components and configurations on OpenWrt devices. It includes functions for reading MAC addresses from device trees, JSON configuration files, MTD partitions, MMC parts, and encrypted sources, as well as utility functions for manipulating MAC addresses.

methods.name: get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads a MAC address binary data from a specified file and offset.

methods.name: get_mac_label_dt
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from device tree via alias.

methods.name: get_mac_label_json
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from /etc/board.json configuration.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Combines device tree and JSON retrieval to get the MAC label.

methods.name: find_mtd_chardev
methods.description: Finds character device path for a given MTD partition.

methods.name: get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts MAC address in ASCII form from a partition part.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Retrieves MAC in ASCII from a specified MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Decrypts and retrieves MAC address from an Arcadyan encrypted MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Decrypts and retrieves MAC address from a Deco encrypted MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Reads MAC address from UCI configuration in UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Gets MAC address stored as text from an MTD partition at specific offset.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Retrieves MAC binary data from a specified MTD partition and offset.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Retrieves MAC binary data from a UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_part_size
methods.description: Returns size of an MTD partition by name.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Retrieves MAC in ASCII format from an MMC partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Retrieves MAC in binary format from an MMC partition.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the CID of an MMC device.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Formats MAC address as EUI string.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Unsets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the 'locally administered' bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the multicast bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_random
methods.description: Generates a random MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Converts various MAC address formats to canonical form.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if device tree node is enabled.

methods.name: get_linux_version
methods.description: Returns a numerical version of the Linux kernel.
